text:
Nora: Noticing a usability regression on small phones: the table overflow + collapsible sidebar causes the row action (kebab) to be pushed under the collapsed rail when in touch mode. Quick vid: https://imgur.com/shortclip.mp4
Kei: repro on iPhone 11. Steps: narrow viewport -> collapse rail -> tap row -> kebab is visually visible but touch target misses because rail hit area extends 8px beyond visual edge.
Hal: suspect CSS margin/padding bleed. Found `.rail { padding-right: 8px }` synced with `overflow: visible` so hits are larger. Quick fix: `.rail { overflow: hidden } .rail-inner { padding-right: 0 }` or clamp hit area with `.rail { pointer-events: auto } backdrop { pointer-events: auto }`
Priya: UX asks: at <= 380px width collapse rail to icon-only 64px and move row actions into a small floating affordance above the row when the rail is collapsed. That keeps primary actions reachable without hiding table content. Also change empty state CTA copy to "Create route" (plurality consistency).
Nora: accessibility: when floating affordance appears it must be reachable by keyboard and announced. Add `role="dialog" aria-modal="false"` and `aria-label="Row actions"` on the float. Also ensure `aria-hidden="true"` on table content behind it for SR clarity.
Kei: implementation idea: detect collapsed rail with `window.matchMedia('(max-width: 380px)')` then toggle `.rail--collapsed` and move action DOM into `.row-float` via JS. CSS: `.row-float { position: absolute; right: 72px; bottom: 8px; z-index: 30 }` but absolute positioning needs container `position: relative` on rows.
Hal: dev caveat: avoid lots of DOM movement for perf. Instead render the floating affordance but keep it visually hidden until `.rail--collapsed` and toggle `visibility` + `transform` for animation. Use `will-change: transform` sparingly.
Priya: copy tweak: change primary mobile CTA from "Run" to "Apply" when in inline-edit mode; add aria-label="Apply filters". Also shorten device column header "Last seen" -> "Last active" on small breakpoints.
ux-bot: attached Figma spec: https://figma.com/file/MOBILE/row-float-spec — includes 64px collapsed rail, 72px float offset, and touch target guidelines.
Kei: I'll prototype CSS + small JS toggle behind feature flag. Will include visual tests and device lab capture. Tagging RD-3720 P2.
Nora: thanks — please add e2e for iOS Safari and Android WebView. Merge after QA signoff.
